name_zh: 赫梅利尼茨基/哥萨克首领：边境地带共同体与哥萨克自治
name_en: Khmelnytsky/Cossack Hetmans: Borderland Commonwealth & Cossack Autonomy
description_zh: 博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基 (1595-1657) 领导 1648 年哥萨克起义，建立扎波罗热军队 (Hetmanate)，在波兰-立陶宛联邦/奥斯曼/莫斯科/克里米亚汗国四强夹缝中寻求生存。核心治理模式：哥萨克民主 (拉达大会选举盖特曼/决策战争和约) + 军事行政合一 (团/连制即行政区) + 正教信仰凝聚身份 + 灵活外交平衡 (1654 佩列亚斯拉夫条约投奔沙皇/1658 哈季亚奇条约回归波兰)。体现 M181 边境地带共同体——以"军事民主+信仰锚定+大国间摇摆"三位一体，在文明断层线上构建自治政治共同体。
description_en: Bohdan Khmelnytsky (1595-1657) led 1648 Cossack uprising, established Zaporozhian Host (Hetmanate), seeking survival in four-power squeeze of PLC/Ottoman/Muscovy/Crimean Khanate. Core governance model: Cossack democracy (Rada assembly elects Hetman/decides war & peace) + military-administrative fusion (regiment/company as admin units) + Orthodox faith anchoring identity + flexible diplomatic balancing (1654 Pereiaslav Treaty to Tsar/1658 Hadiach Treaty back to PLC). Exemplifies M181 Borderland Commonwealth—trinity of 'military democracy + faith anchor + great power balancing' building autonomous political community on civilizational fault lines.
reason_zh: 乌克兰历史核心张力在于"边境地带生存"：无天然屏障、多帝国争夺、族群宗教交织。赫梅利尼茨基以哥萨克军事民主+正教身份+大国平衡，在文明断层线上开辟自治空间。M181 区隔于 M163 斯拉夫边境生存(近代)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)、M172 少数派生存(叙利亚)，核心在于"军事民主制+信仰锚定+大国摇摆"的早期现代边境生存范式。
reason_en: Ukraine's core historical tension is 'borderland survival': no natural barriers, multiple empires contesting, ethnic-religious interweaving. Khmelnytsky carved autonomous space via Cossack military democracy + Orthodox identity + great power balancing. M181 distinct from M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (modern), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), M172 Minority Survival (Syria), core: 'military democracy + faith anchor + great power oscillation' early modern borderland survival paradigm.
steps_zh: 哥萨克军事民主确立：拉达大会选举盖特曼、决策战争和约、分配战利品，军官由功绩晋升
正教信仰身份锚定：哥萨克视自己为正教捍卫者，教堂/修道院为社区核心，宗教宽容犹太/天主教商人
大国间灵活摇摆：1648 起义→1654 佩列亚斯拉夫投沙皇→1657 瑞典结盟→1658 哈季亚奇回波兰，生存优先
军事行政合一治理：团/连制即军事单位即行政区，盖特曼任命团长兼行政长官，战时即战时
遗产与分裂：1667 安德鲁索沃休战割裂第聂伯河左右岸→左岸归沙皇/右岸归波兰，哥萨克自治在大国博弈中碎片化
steps_en: Cossack military democracy establishment: Rada assembly elects Hetman, decides war/peace, distributes spoils, officers promoted by merit
Orthodox faith identity anchoring: Cossacks see themselves as Orthodox defenders, churches/monasteries as community cores, religious tolerance for Jewish/Catholic merchants
Great power flexible oscillation: 1648 uprising -> 1654 Pereiaslav to Tsar -> 1657 Swedish alliance -> 1658 Hadiach back to PLC, survival first
Military-administrative fusion governance: regiment/company as both military unit and admin district, Hetman appoints colonels as admin chiefs, wartime = governance
Legacy & partition: 1667 Truce of Andrusovo splits Dnieper banks -> left bank to Tsar/right bank to PLC, Cossack autonomy fragmented in great power games
expected_zh: 以"军事民主+正教身份+大国摇摆"三位一体，在文明断层线上实现边境族群的自治生存，为后世乌克兰国家建构提供史诗级原型。
expected_en: Trinity of 'military democracy + Orthodox identity + great power oscillation' achieves borderland ethnic autonomy survival on civilizational fault lines, providing epic prototype for later Ukrainian state-building.
case_zh: 1648 起义→1654 佩列亚斯拉夫→1657-58 瑞典/波兰结盟→1667 安德鲁索沃割裂→1709 波尔塔瓦战役马泽帕倒向瑞典→1764 叶卡捷琳娜二世废除盖特曼制，哥萨克自治在大国博弈中消亡但精神延续。
case_en: 1648 uprising -> 1654 Pereiaslav -> 1657-58 Swedish/PLC alliance -> 1667 Andrusovo partition -> 1709 Poltava Mazepa defects to Sweden -> 1764 Catherine II abolishes Hetmanate, Cossack autonomy perishes in great power games but spirit endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Cossack democracy model; Ukrainian national myth; borderland survival paradigm
colonial_history: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth rule; Russian Empire expansion; Soviet period
resource_curse_mitigation: Black soil agriculture; Dnieper hydro; Donbas coal (later)
